title: Report, fix, tell
sub: The second film of Quality as a habit, in Data quality: people find errors no check can see, so make it easy to report one where they see the data, send each report to its owner with a promise of when, fix it where it started, tell the person who reported it and the people who made the data, and turn each kind of error into a check.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, the quality bench: a limestone wall over a granite bench, lit from a window on the right. Records are cream cards, and results are tags tied on with string: green passes, amber holds for a person, red stops, grey wasn't checked. Brass is what good means, here a promise and its due date; steel blue is a measure, such as a count of reports.
